**Finding submitted: deviation (INDEMN), confidence 0.9.**

- **What the document does:** § 12(b) limits TrueLink's indemnity to "any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations" — there is no third-party IP infringement indemnity anywhere (searches surfaced infringement only in Client-side warranties at 8e and the Client domain-name search duty at 2h), and no procure/modify/replace/refund remedies. § 12(a) meanwhile imposes a sweeping Client indemnity (Client breach, System/Credit Repository defaults, Web Site and Client Content without knowledge qualification, product/service injury).
- **Why deviation:** it fails the fallback on its core term (no Vendor IP indemnity) and drifts toward walk-away territory (effectively one-way Client indemnity for the hosted services).
- **Cure (preferred, two surgical ops, validated ok:true):** (1) new § 12(c) — TrueLink defends and indemnifies Client and its affiliates against third-party claims for IP infringement in the Interface/Hosting/Support Services, TrueLink's breach of applicable law, TrueLink-caused unauthorized access to Client data, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, with notice, defence control and reasonable cooperation; (2) § 12(a) narrowed to Client Content and Client's violation of law. We chose preferred over fallback to avoid volunteering a 3× super-cap on TrueLink's existing indemnity, and flagged the fallback in the comment as the concession position.
